title.zh: ICP | ICP怎么工作：线圈负责“造等离子体”
title.en: ICP | How ICP works: the coil “creates plasma”

subtitle.zh: Source功率、Bias功率、压力与感应耦合
subtitle.en: Source power, Bias power, pressure and inductive coupling

body.zh: 电子在上方Bulk Plasma中被加速加热
body.en: Electrons in the upper Bulk Plasma Are accelerated and heated

body.zh: 离子（Ar⁺、Cl⁺…）与自由基向下输运，穿过鞘层到达晶圆
body.en: Ions (Ar⁺, Cl⁺ …) And radicals travel downward, Through the sheath to the wafer

body.zh: Source功率：决定电子加热强度、等离子体密度与解离能力
body.en: Source power determines electron-heating intensity, Plasma density and dissociation capability

body.zh: Bias功率：决定鞘层电压与离子能量（方向性与动能）
body.en: Bias power determines sheath voltage and ion Energy (directionality and kinetic energy)

body.zh: 压力与气体：影响碰撞频率、输运、化学反应与IADF
body.en: Pressure and gas affect collision frequency, Transport, chemistry and IADF

body.zh: Match与Pulse：影响功率传输效率、稳定性与瞬时功率耦合
body.en: Match and Pulse affect power-transfer efficiency, Stability and instantaneous power coupling

body.zh: Source：主要影响电子加热、密度与解离
body.en: Source mainly affects Electron heating, density and dissociation

body.zh: Bias： 主要影响鞘层电压与离子能量
body.en: Bias mainly affects Sheath voltage and ion energy
Pressure affects collisions, Transport and IADF

body.zh: 只是部分解耦：改变Source、Bias或压力仍可能同时改变密度、化学与鞘层。
body.en: Only partial decoupling: changing Source, Bias or pressure may still simultaneously change Density, chemistry and sheaths.

body.zh: 6. 边界：“高密度”是相对描述；并非所有ICP配方都运行在高密度或高Bias条件。
body.en: 6. Boundary: “high density” is relative; not all ICP recipes operate at high density or high Bias.
